svg.title: Scheduled summaries by email — SoftTrack web design mockup (#285)
svg.desc: Reports are pages somebody has to open, and the people who most want the summary are the least likely to be in the tracker. A subscription sends a team’s week, an epic’s status, the portfolio or one’s own week by email on a schedule, with numbers as text, what the recipient may see decided per recipient, and an unsubscribe link.
svg.text: · the report, for the people who never open it
The week, on a Monday morning

g.text: an email, to somebody who is not in the tracker that day
Invoice PDF renders blank on Safari
Open the sprint · Open the reports ·
Each member can unsubscribe. Team admins only.
You will not get “Engineering: the week” again
Sent to sofia@northwind.dev. You can turn it back on

svg.text: Done when a person can subscribe to a team’s week, an epic’s status, the portfolio or their own week, weekly, every two weeks or monthly; a team admin can subscribe the team
and each member can unsubscribe; the email carries numbers as text and tables and reads without images; what a recipient may see is decided when the email is built; every
email has an unsubscribe link that works without signing in; and nothing is offered without SMTP.
